[[Vault 33]] |TV actor = }} '''Ava West''' was a pre-War junior executive of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] and member of [[Bud's Buds]] who was preserved in [[Vault 31]] and later became the overseer of [[Vault 33]] from [[Timeline#2109|2109]] to 2121. ==Background== Ava was a Vault-Tec junior employee selected to participate in [[Bud Askins]]' executive assistant training program "[[Bud's Buds]]," a plan to create "super managers" who would define the future of humanity after the [[Great War]] wiped out all competitors to Vault-Tec. West and the other Buds would be kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in Vault 31, periodically thawed out, and transferred to [[Vault 32]] or Vault 33 to manage the dwellers and participate in controlled breeding (eugenics), all under Askins' supervision.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"So what's Vault 32 and 33? Just people to be controlled?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"What? No! When you put it like that, it sounds downright morally questionable. They're our breeding pool, the ultimate expression of HR R&D. Genetically selected to breed with my Buds to create a class of super managers. People with positivity, people who make lemonade. People who will inherit the Earth after we've wiped the surface clean."''
("[[The Beginning]]")[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"Is this where my dad's from?"''
[[Bud Askins]]: ''"You'll never find out. Oh. He's gonna find out. These are Bud's Buds. My Buds. America outsourced the survival of this country to the private sector. But it would have been insane to keep a failed nation alive. So, we kept Vault-Tec alive instead. A well-trained staff of highly supervised junior executives from my own assistant training program. Because the future of humanity comes down to one word: Management."''
("[[The Beginning]]") Following the Great War, Ava was eventually thawed out and sent to Vault 33. She succeeded [[Robert Olsen]] as overseer in 2109 and held that position until being replaced by [[George Yaffe]] in 2121.Inter-Vault Archive seen on terminal screen: ''"The following is a record of Inter-vault Trades implemented for the distribution of personnel''
